messages:
Leah: finalizing webinar run-of-show — quick read before rehearsal at 9:30 PT tomorrow. agenda below. @channel

Leah: run-of-show:
- 0:00 welcome + goals (Leah)
- 3:00 benchmark quick hits: cost vs latency (Owen)
- 8:00 demo: hosted -> dedicated failover + model switch (Owen)
- 16:00 Q&A + CTA -> HubSpot form (Maya)
- 22:00 close

Owen: demo plan: primary = redwood/v1-small (hosted), fallback = redwood/v1-medium-quant (dedicated). I'll show routing change, p95 graph, and a tiny latency injection. Keep prompts short to avoid quantization diffs.

Maya: HubSpot mapping: hs_webinar = "april_launch_2026", hs_interest = "hosting|dedicated|private", hidden field demo_variant = "model_demo_variant", utm_campaign = "april_launch". I'll wire a workflow to tag leads and add them to the follow-up list.

Leah: Owen — paste exact switch + reset commands so stage manager can copy into the runbook.

Owen: commands (DEMO_TOKEN set on demo VM):
```
# switch to fallback (dedicated)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/routes/switch
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"route":"live-demo","target":"redwood/v1-medium-quant","reason":"latency_fallback"}'
```

```
# reset to primary (hosted)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/routes/switch
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"route":"live-demo","target":"redwood/v1-small","reason":"post_demo_reset"}'
```

Leah: OpsBot, please schedule a prewarm for the dedicated pool ~8 minutes before start.

OpsBot: scheduled: prewarm dedicated pool for live-demo at 2026-04-10T16:22:00Z (requested by Owen).

Maya: I'll own live chat lead drops and canned replies; Leah will triage technical/SLA questions. Recording + captions start 9:25 PT. Greenroom at 9:10 PT. See you all in rehearsal. :rocket:
